_help: Per-game settings. Fill in during recon (guides/01_RECON_WITH_REA.md). Paths are relative to work/ext/ unless noted.

bmg._help: Nintendo EAD BMG (MESGbmg1, UTF-16). Zelda PH/ST, many first-party EAD titles.

g4._help: Pokemon Gen IV encrypted message NARC (HGSS paths shown). Verify paths for DP/Pt with REA.

custom._help: Settings for tools/adapters/custom.py when you write a new codec for an unknown format.
